decisive_items: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
response.rationale: Histopathology shows malignant vascular proliferation with CD31 positivity, SMA positivity, and necrosis, fitting angiosarcoma. Hemangioma lacks mitoses/necrosis; Kaposi sarcoma is excluded by negative HHV8; SCC is contradicted by histology.

rejected.why: Negative Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus staining excludes Kaposi sarcoma.
Benign hemangioma would not show cytologic atypia, mitoses, and necrosis.
Histopathology shows vascular, not squamous, differentiation despite prior SCC history.
